messages:
Zoe: Heads-up: post-deploy were seeing billing ledger attribute tokens to an internal proxy route while console shows original router. Small but visible delta (~0.15%).
Marco: any trace id?
Zoe: trace=prx-21, shard=eu-central, router=router-v4 -> proxy-rewrite. Snippet: 
Zoe: ```
[2026-05-18T10:22:01Z] session=prx-21 route=router-v4
[2026-05-18T10:22:01Z] handoff: router->proxy (proxy rewrote X-Route=proxy-internal)
[2026-05-18T10:22:02Z] chunk acked ledger_tag=lt-710 ledger_route=proxy-internal
```
Leah: that matches a header-normalization change in the proxy layer last week. If the ledger consumes X-Route at ingest time well get mismatch.
Marco: query to find affected sessions: 
Marco: ```sql
SELECT s.session_id, s.route as console_route, l.route as ledger_route, count(*) c
FROM sessions s JOIN ledger_entries l USING(session_id)
WHERE s.created_at > '2026-05-10' AND s.route != l.route
GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>5;
```
infra-bot: alert "route_rewrite_ledger_mismatch" fired (0.15%). Incident INC-7788 created.
Zoe: short-term: ledger ingest can prefer X-Meter-Original header when present. Long-term: stop proxies from overwriting meter headers or copy original into X-Meter-Original before rewrite.
Leah: agreed. I can open a small ledger ingest patch to prefer X-Meter-Original if present and add an audit metric. Marco: can you handle router/proxy change to copy original header?
Marco: will do. Patch idea (router/proxy): 
Marco: ```go
orig := req.Header.Get("X-Route")
if orig != "" {
 req.Header.Set("X-Meter-Original", orig)
}
// proxy may set X-Route later
```
Zoe: also ask console: add a column comparing console_route vs ledger_route, and flag rows where they differ. That helps CS.
ops-bot: linked INC-7788 to dashboard update ticket DT-1432.
Leah: timeline: ledger ingest hotfix today -> proxy patch + canary tomorrow -> monitor 2h. If mismatch persists >0.1% rollback canary.
Zoe: thanks team. Keeping thread for follow-up and postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
